what.text: This page follows refugees from Uganda in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12792 refugees from Uganda.
Canada hosts the largest share, 34.3%, followed by the United States, the United Kingdom and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda in many years from 1971, at war level in some of them, and an interstate armed conflict between Tanzania and Uganda in 1978.
From 1994 to 2011 the government's opponents it records include the LRA, ADF, WNBF and UNRF II.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1973 at 950 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 315346, at the end of 1983, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1980 to 1986.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
